units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:3:4">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:4:7">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> top <he>עד דלא יקום על בְּרָרֵיה וכ׳</he> as long as the gold ore is not reduced to its pure state, it looses much in the smelting process; but when once brought to its pure state, nothing is lost.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:2:2">Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵇ</cite> top; XV, 15ᵃ <he>דו משים</he> (<he>מקים</he>) … <he>על ב׳</he> because he based the matter on truth (gave a clear decision).
